reponse:
I don't know — there's no agreed per-payout price from Corvane for next year in what I found.

What I can say: Corvane bills us a **per-item ACH fee**, not a per-payout one, and the Q1 2027 pricing memo assumes it "stays at $0.08 in 2027" (the current agreement runs to March 31, 2027) [2]. That's an internal assumption, not a quote from Corvane.

The renewal is still open: the call with our RM Paula Brandt slipped to the week of Nov 23, she "hinted they want to raise the per-item fee after the Nov 10 reject mess", and there's "nothing on paper yet" [8]. The memo only sets a threshold: if the fee goes above $0.10, the bottom tier gets revisited [2]. For context, October's Corvane invoice was $14,212.40 on 177,655 ACH items [13].

I searched for "Corvane" and "Corvane per payout pricing next year", and read the Q1 2027 pricing memo and the #finance thread. If a number comes out of the renewal call, it probably lands in #finance or in Marcus's renewal notes — not here yet.
